title: Cow in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='68' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='52' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#4a4a5a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <rect x='43' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <rect x='55' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <rect x='66' y='78' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='89' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='43' y='89' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='55' y='89' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='89' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M22 48 Q30 42 50 42 Q70 42 78 48 L78 54 Q70 48 50 48 Q30 48 22 54 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <rect x='70' y='48' width='10' height='20' rx='3' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <rect x='70' y='62' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff8c7a'/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <rect x='24' y='46' width='4' height='6' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='34' y='44' width='4' height='6' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='44' y='43' width='4' height='6' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='54' y='43' width='4' height='6' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='64' y='44' width='4' height='6' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#f5f0e6'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='28' rx='7' ry='4' transform='rotate(-20 29 28)' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='28' rx='7' ry='4' transform='rotate(20 71 28)' fill='#e8dfd0'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='28' rx='4' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(-20 29 28)' fill='#f0a8a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='28' rx='4' ry='2.5' transform='rotate(20 71 28)' fill='#f0a8a0'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M40 21 Q36 12 42 10 Q44 15 44 20 Z' fill='#f0e0b0'/>
  <path d='M60 21 Q64 12 58 10 Q56 15 56 20 Z' fill='#f0e0b0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='3.5' fill='#2a2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#f0a8a0'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#c4756e'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#c4756e'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 45 Q50 49 55 45' stroke='#c4756e' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 60 Q88 58 86 70' stroke='#e8dfd0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='72' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
</svg>
